title: Validate successful LTE and 5G NSA attach and detach for single UE under excellent radio conditions
preconditions: Single cell test environment configured with one active UE under excellent radio conditions (LTE RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP as per Clause 4.6)
Network elements (O-RAN components) are operational with no connectivity issues
Test configuration recorded and serving cell activated, all other cells powered off
testSteps: Start test log capture for call flow and signalling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate attach procedure
Wait for successful attach completion validated by attach request and attach complete messages
Verify UE is attached to correct cell by checking UE logs or applications for PCI, Global eNB/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach procedure
Wait for successful detach completion validated by detach request and detach accept messages, including UE context release and RRC connection release messages
Stop and save test logs
Repeat above steps for 10 iterations
Calculate and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency (min, average, max) in test report according to Table 5-2 and Table 5-3
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rate is 100% for 10 consecutive iterations
Attach latency measured and recorded correctly with min, average, and max values
UE logs confirm correct cell attachment parameters
Signalling message flows confirm successful attach and detach per 3GPP TS 23.401 and TS 37.340 where applicable
postconditions: Test logs saved for KPI validation and gap analysis
verificationMethods: Analyze test logs for attach/detach request and response messages
Check UE logs or installed applications for cell identity parameters
Validate signalling message flows for correct procedures

title: Validate UE attach failure handling when UE power ON does not trigger attach
preconditions: Single cell test environment with one UE under excellent radio conditions
Network elements operational
testSteps: Start log capture for signalling and call flow
Simulate UE Power ON but block or drop attach request messages from UE
Observe system behavior and wait for attach timeout or failure indication
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails gracefully with proper error reporting
No partial attach or inconsistent UE state in network
System logs error or timeout events related to attach failure
verificationMethods: Verify absence of attach complete messages in logs
Check for error or timeout messages in network logs
Confirm UE is not considered attached in system state

title: Validate network behavior when UE power OFF does not trigger detach procedure
preconditions: Single cell test environment with one UE attached under excellent radio conditions
Network elements operational
testSteps: Start log capture
Power OFF the UE but simulate loss or blocking of detach request messages
Observe network handling of missing detach messages
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Network detects missing detach and releases resources after timeout or error handling
No resource leakage or stuck UE contexts in network
Proper error or timer expiry events logged
verificationMethods: Confirm absence of detach accept messages
Verify network timers or error logs trigger resource cleanup
Check no residual UE connection state remains

title: Measure attach latency at boundary of excellent radio conditions
preconditions: Single cell test setup with radio conditions set exactly at minimum coupling loss limit for LTE RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP as defined in Clause 4.6
One active UE configured
testSteps: Start log capture
Power ON UE and trigger attach procedure
Measure attach latency from attach request to attach complete
Power OFF UE and detach
Repeat for 10 iterations
Record min, avg, max attach latency values
expectedResults: Attach latency values recorded reflect boundary radio conditions
Attach and detach success rates remain 100%
No attach failures due to radio condition boundary
postconditions: Logs and latency metrics saved for performance baseline
verificationMethods: Analyze signalling timestamps in logs for latency measurements
Verify radio measurement reports for boundary conditions

title: Evaluate attach and detach success rate and latency under repeated attach/detach cycles
preconditions: Single cell test environment with one UE under excellent radio conditions
Network elements operational and test configuration recorded
testSteps: Start continuous logging
Perform attach and detach cycle 10 times consecutively by powering UE ON and OFF
Measure attach success, detach success, and attach latency for each iteration
Aggregate and record KPIs in test report
expectedResults: 100% attach and detach success rate across 10 iterations
Attach latency within acceptable limits as per KPI targets
No degradation or failures due to repeated cycles
postconditions: Test logs and KPI data saved
Gap analysis provided comparing measured KPIs to target values
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for success/failure in each iteration
Calculate latency statistics
Compare KPIs with expected targets

title: Verify system rejects attach attempts from unauthenticated or invalid UE
preconditions: Single cell test environment operational
UE configured with invalid or revoked credentials
testSteps: Start logging
Power ON UE with invalid credentials and initiate attach
Observe network attach rejection procedure
Stop logging
expectedResults: Attach request is rejected by network
No UE context created or accepted
Appropriate error or reject messages logged
Network does not allocate resources to invalid UE
verificationMethods: Check logs for attach reject messages
Verify no UE context exists in network management
Confirm error codes conform to expected standards

title: Validate EN-DC secondary node addition and release procedures during 5G NSA attach and detach
preconditions: Single cell configured for 5G NSA with MN and SN nodes operational
UE under excellent radio conditions attached to LTE cell
testSteps: Start log capture
Power ON UE and initiate 5G NSA attach including EN-DC secondary node addition
Validate SgNB addition request and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.2.1
Power OFF UE to initiate UE-initiated detach including secondary node release
Validate detach request, detach accept, and SgNB release procedures per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1
Repeat 10 times
Record attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, and detach success rate
expectedResults: 100% success rate for attach, secondary node addition, and detach procedures
Secondary node resources released properly with UE context release and RRC connection release messages
Signalling flows conform to the specified 3GPP procedures
postconditions: Logs and KPI data saved for integration analysis
verificationMethods: Review signalling logs for SgNB addition and release messages
Confirm UE context release at secondary node
Verify consistency of message sequence with 3GPP TS 37.340

Test engineers with varied experience levels

expectedResults: Test engineers understand and follow test steps correctly with minimal questions
Feedback indicates instructions are clear and unambiguous
No critical missing information identified
postconditions: Document improvements suggested based on feedback

Observation of test execution
Review of error or misinterpretation instances

preconditions: Test configured in laboratory using variable attenuator/fading generator or UE emulator for radio condition control

testSteps: Perform attach-detach test as per procedure in lab setup with radio condition emulation
Perform attach-detach test as per procedure in field setup with real radio conditions
Record KPIs and success rates from both setups
Compare results for consistency
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates meet 100% criteria in both setups
KPIs like attach latency and RSRP/SS-RSRP measurements are consistent and within expected ranges
Test procedure adaptable to both lab and field environments
postconditions: Test report includes setup differences and comparative analysis
verificationMethods: Compare KPI tables from lab and field tests
Analyze radio measurement logs
Confirm test setup configurations documented

Network elements capable of handling repeated signalling
testSteps: Start continuous logging
Perform 10 attach-detach cycles with minimum delay between UE power ON and OFF

Analyze network load and resource usage during test
expectedResults: Network maintains 100% attach and detach success rate
Signalling latency remains within acceptable performance thresholds
No signalling congestion or message loss occurs
verificationMethods: Analyze timestamps in signalling logs
Monitor network resource utilization statistics
Check for message loss or retransmissions

Network configured with access control policies

Attempt SN release procedure from unauthorized node
Stop logging
expectedResults: Detach requests from unauthorized entities are rejected
Secondary Node Release procedures require proper authorization

verificationMethods: Check for reject messages in signalling logs

title: Validate coordination and timing between Master Node and Secondary Node during SN Release
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with MN and SN operational
UE attached under excellent radio conditions
testSteps: Initiate SN Release procedure from MN side and capture signalling messages
Initiate SN Release procedure from SN side and capture signalling messages
Verify order and timing of SgNB Release Request, SgNB Release Request Acknowledge, SgNB Release Required, and SgNB Release Confirm messages
Check data forwarding start and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message timing
Observe UE RRCConnectionReconfiguration messages indicating SCG release
Repeat for multiple detach cycles
expectedResults: MN and SN release procedures follow defined message sequences
Data forwarding and reporting coordinated to minimize service gaps
UE receives appropriate configuration to release SCG
No race conditions or message conflicts occur
postconditions: Detailed signalling logs preserved for analysis
verificationMethods: Analyze timestamps and order of signalling messages
Verify coordination notes in logs
Confirm UE state transitions per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1

title: Evaluate ease of starting, stopping, and saving logs during attach-detach test procedure
preconditions: Test setup with logging tools installed and accessible
testSteps: Start test log capture before UE power ON
Stop and save logs immediately after UE detach completes
Repeat process for all iterations
Collect feedback on user interface, responsiveness, and reliability of logging tools
expectedResults: Logging is straightforward and requires minimal steps
Logs are saved correctly without data loss
Test operators report high usability and clarity
verificationMethods: User surveys and interviews
Review of log completeness and correctness

testSteps: Perform attach-detach test 10 iterations with real UE
Perform attach-detach test 10 iterations with UE emulator
Record KPIs for both cases including attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency
Compare results for discrepancies
expectedResults: KPIs for real UE and UE emulator are consistent within acceptable tolerance
No unexpected behavior observed in either case
Test procedure validated across device types
verificationMethods: Analyze KPI tables for both devices
Check logs for differences in signalling or timing
